text:
ITEM 1 | Shredded pale yellow-white strands with thin orange carrot shreds and bright green pea-like pieces mixed in, plus some torn green herb leaves; strands are thin, slightly glossy and moist-looking, mounded loosely on the left side of the plate covering roughly 30% of the plate footprint, about 5-6 cm tall at the center | 150

ITEM 2 | Brown-to-tan mixed mound with crumbly, grainy texture, darker brown bits and small pale strands, dotted with green herb leaves and a few light yellow strands on top; spread across the upper right of the plate covering roughly 25% of the footprint, about 3 cm tall, slightly moist and clumpy | 130

ITEM 3 | Orange-red glazed pieces with a slightly glossy, sticky-looking surface and some browned caramelized edges, cut into elongated wedge-like chunks about 4-6 cm long and 1.5-2.5 cm thick, clustered at the lower right of the plate covering roughly 12% of the footprint, firm and holding shape | 90

ITEM 4 | Thin pale yellow noodle-like strands scattered as a few loose pieces at the lower center of the plate, dry-looking and lightly golden, about 1 cm footprint each, very small amount | 8
